name: dsh-session-manager
description: Archived-session management for DSH: permanent delete entry for archived sessions (sidebar menu + agent tool), with ghost-residue cleanup, residency diagnostics, and a force escape hatch for resident idle sessions.

meta.title: Session Manager
meta.description: Adds a permanent Delete entry to archived sessions' row menu and a session_delete agent tool. Only archived sessions can be deleted; a resident or running session is refused until it settles, ghost residue (archive entry whose files are gone) cleans up through the same flow, and a resident-but-idle session can be force-deleted (running work always refuses).
